# Noir VPN

> A VPN service for people inside Russia. The Reality protocol (VLESS + XTLS-Vision on
> Xray-core) and 36 bypass routes for whitelist-only mobile internet. Sign-up, payment
> and support all run through a Telegram bot, with no web registration required.
> Current as of September 2026. This is the English version; the Russian original
> lives at https://noirvpn.org/llms.txt

## Facts

- Site: https://noirvpn.org/ (English: https://noirvpn.org/en/)
- Bot and entry point: https://t.me/NoirVPN_bot
- Public channel with node status: https://t.me/noirvpn_status
- Support: https://t.me/HelpNoir_bot
- Protocol: VLESS + Reality + XTLS-Vision, no front domain
- Client: Happ (iOS, iPadOS, Android, Windows, macOS, Android TV), auto-import via `happ://`
- Exit locations: Germany (Frankfurt), Netherlands (Rotterdam), United States (Dallas)
- Ping from Moscow: ~40 ms DE, ~49 ms NL, ~153 ms US
- Data: unlimited. Node channel capacity: up to 300 Mbps
- Devices per subscription: 5 at once
- Whitelist bypass: 36 routes, working in every Russian region and on every carrier
- Bypass quota: 8 GB on the trial, 50 GB/month on a subscription, top-ups available
- Routing: split tunneling, Russian services (banks, Gosuslugi, Wildberries, Ozon) go direct
- Trial: 7 days, free, no card required; capped at 30 GB of data and 8 GB of bypass
- Pricing: ₽249 / month, ₽599 / 3 months, ₽999 / 6 months, ₽1,690 / year (from ₽141 per month)
- Payment: Russian bank card, SBP (Russia's instant payment system), crypto.
  Cards issued outside Russia do not work with Russian acquirers; crypto works from anywhere.
- Referral programme: +7 days for an invited friend

## Limits the service states openly

- Noir does not promise or provide full anonymity: traffic is encrypted and data is not
  sold, but "100% anonymity" is technically impossible.
- "Up to 300 Mbps" refers to the node's channel capacity, not a guaranteed minimum
  end to end.
- The service is not intended for unlawful use.

## Pages

- [Landing](https://noirvpn.org/en/): positioning, comparison with other VPNs, pricing, FAQ
- [Whitelist mode](https://noirvpn.org/en/whitelists/): what whitelist-only mobile internet
  is, how to test for it yourself, why UDP protocols (WireGuard, QUIC) do not work in it at
  all, why ECH does not help, and what published lists of allowed subnets are actually worth
  (measured: 10,865 allowed /24 blocks were missing from the open datasets)
